title: IRIS as a named immune-reconstitution syndrome
dek: Wikipedia's IRIS page is the HIV-ART unmasking/paradoxical flare. ART timing stays on tb-hiv-art.
story: IRIS on Wikipedia is a named flare when a reconstituting immune system notices pathogens it had been ignoring. TB-IRIS is unmasking (disease appearing after ART) or paradoxical (known TB worsening after ART).
This is not microbiologic failure by default and not a reason to stop TB drugs without a work-up. Simplfy's HIV-ART plate owns timing (when to start ART relative to TB therapy).
Steroids in some paradoxical TBM/IRIS settings are clinic judgement on the meningitis/HIV plates — not an encyclopedia dose.
deep: Culture still matters: true failure and DR-TB hide under 'IRIS' labels.
CD4 rise and viral drop are epidemiologic hints, not pathognomonic tests.
Cryptococcus IRIS is a neighbour that can share a ward.
Do not delay ART forever 'to avoid IRIS' against WHO timing evidence — that argument lives on tb-hiv-art.

visual.caption: ART reconstitution can unmask or paradoxically inflame TB. Distinguish from microbiologic failure.
